statements.statement: CPT 93247 long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered
Patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
Patient has significant history of transient ischemic attacks (Z86.73, G45.9)
Ordering clinician documented concern that intermittent arrhythmia may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
Extended continuous monitoring is required to correlate patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
Claim was denied with reason code CO-197
CO-197 denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before service was rendered
